Title: Diagnosis
Details:
The failing test case `testLang412Right` attempts to append a null value with fixed width padding on the right using `appendFixedWidthPadRight(null, 10, '*')`.

Inspecting the implementation of `StrBuilder.appendFixedWidthPadRight(Object obj, int width, char padChar)`:
- The method converts the `obj` argument to a String by either calling `obj.toString()` if `obj` is not null, or calling `getNullText()` if it is null.
- `getNullText()` returns the value of the field `nullText`.
- In `StrBuilder`, `nullText` appears to be a field that can be set via `setNullText(String)`.
- However, if `nullText` is not explicitly set, its default value is `null`.
- The code does not null-check the result of `getNullText()` before calling `str.length()`, which leads to a NullPointerException when the null `nullText` is returned.

The current bug report confirms this: appending a null value with fixed width causes an NPE if `getNullText()` has not been set.

Hence, the root cause is that `appendFixedWidthPadRight` assumes `getNullText()` never returns null, which is not true, causing the NPE when appending null values without a null text set in the `StrBuilder`.

This matches the behavior observed in the test and the issue described in the current bug report. No recent bug reports add relevant information.

Fix should ensure that `appendFixedWidthPadRight` safely handles a null return from `getNullText()`, for instance by treating null as empty string or a safe default.

Suggested locations for fix: `StrBuilder.appendFixedWidthPadRight(Object, int, char)` and possibly the `setNullText` or constructor to ensure `nullText` is never null.

Based on the available information, provide the signatures of the most likely culprit methods for the bug. Your answer will be processed automatically, so make sure to only answer with the accurate signatures of all likely culprits (in `ClassName.MethodName(ArgType1, ArgType2, ...)` format), without commentary (one per line).
